title: [NatWest demo] Payments OTel - per-service p99 latency SLO breach
description:
Reads OTel server spans (index=otel_traces sourcetype=otel:traces kind=SPAN_KIND_SERVER) and computes the p99 request latency per service.name over the last 5 minutes. Fires one ITSI notable per service when p99 exceeds the service's declared SLO (sourced from the same thresholds the ITSI service tree uses in itsi/service-tree.yaml KPIs, kept in sync via the inline case() lookup below). Pairs with EVERY chaos scenario that injects latency at a specific layer without taking the chain down:
  - db-slow                  -> ledger-service p99 > 800ms
  - tail-latency-storm       -> payment-validation-service p99 > 2500ms
  - latency-creep            -> payment-status-service p99 > 800ms
  - fraud-cpu-regression     -> fraud-detection-service p99 > 1500ms
  - madrid-network-degradation -> api-gateway/payment-initiation p99 > 3000ms (also fires the dedicated madrid p95 search)
  - cache-cold / sanctions-cache-disabled -> sanctions-aml-service p99 > 1500ms
  - gateway-timeout-squeeze  -> not this search (timeouts surface as 5xx, see api_gateway_5xx_breach)

Service routing: the case() at the end maps service.name back to the ITSI L2 tile so the notable rolls up into the same Episode as the chaos audit (NEAP groups by service field). The SLO multipliers are deliberately 2x the threshold from service-tree.yaml so steady-state p99 wobble doesn't generate notable noise - we want "sustained breach" not "transient spike". The cohort_key collapses repeated firings on the same service within the same 5-minute bin.
search: index=otel_traces sourcetype="otel:traces" kind="SPAN_KIND_SERVER" | rename "service.name" AS svc | search svc IN ("ledger-service","payment-validation-service","payment-status-service","fraud-detection-service","sanctions-aml-service","payment-initiation-service","api-gateway","routing-service") | eval duration_ns = coalesce(duration_ns, end_time - start_time) | bin _time span=5m | stats perc99(duration_ns) AS p99_ns, count AS total BY _time, svc | where total >= 30 | eval p99_ms = round(p99_ns / 1000000, 0) | eval slo_ms = case(svc="ledger-service", 1600, svc="payment-validation-service", 5000, svc="payment-status-service", 1500, svc="fraud-detection-service", 3000, svc="sanctions-aml-service", 3000, svc="payment-initiation-service", 6000, svc="api-gateway", 5000, svc="routing-service", 3000, true(), 10000) | where p99_ms > slo_ms | eval breach_factor = round(p99_ms / slo_ms, 2) | eval per_svc = svc . " " . p99_ms . "ms (SLO " . slo_ms . ", x" . breach_factor . ")" | eval routing_tile = case(svc="ledger-service", "Ledger & Settlement Services", svc IN ("sanctions-aml-service","fraud-detection-service"), "Business Services", true(), "Payment Services") | stats max(breach_factor) AS worst_breach, dc(svc) AS num_svc, values(per_svc) AS svc_details, values(routing_tile) AS tiles, max(p99_ms) AS worst_p99_ms BY _time | eval severity = case(worst_breach >= 3, "6", worst_breach >= 2, "5", true(), "4") | eval service = if(mvcount(tiles) = 1, mvindex(tiles, 0), "Payment Services") | eval title = "Service latency SLO breach: " . num_svc . " service(s) over SLO, worst breach x" . worst_breach . " (" . worst_p99_ms . "ms p99)" | eval source = "Splunk ES - payments OTel" | eval cohort_key = "latency_slo:" . strftime(_time, "%Y%m%d%H%M") | eval description = title . " - per-service breakdown: " . mvjoin(svc_details, " | ") . ". Independent symptom that one or more services are breaching their declared SLOs. Pair with the chaos_injection_audit notable in the same Episode to confirm whether a chaos scenario is responsible. SLO values mirror the warning/critical thresholds in itsi/service-tree.yaml KPI definitions (doubled to suppress steady-state wobble). When a single tile is affected the notable routes to that tile; when multiple are affected it routes to Payment Services to surface the cross-cutting nature." | table _time, severity, service, title, source, worst_breach, num_svc, svc_details, worst_p99_ms, cohort_key, description
action.itsi_event_generator.param.title: $result.title$
